message: I remember a winter storm that hit just as I was planning a cozy evening with the grandkids. Instead of fretting over the weather, we turned it into an adventure—hot cocoa, board games, and watching the snow blanket the world outside. 🌨️ If you’re curious about how to make a stormy day a little cozier, check out some thoughtful tips on staying prepared while enjoying the indoors. What’s your favorite indoor activity when the weather turns wild?
